answer: A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The river multiplier is published, charged in comet, and tundra lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 11 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 4366 identities would post 4627 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
